Actual selected native Android permission/channel and iOS capability/environment/configuration work on the accepted signed test artifact.
Configured public browser key and server-only provider credentials match exact isolated environment; malformed/missing configuration fails safely.
Selected actual provider/SDK registration freshness/change/retirement protocol is implemented; no hard-coded obsolete token schema or trust in caller device ID.
Native wrapper does not expose a falsely successful browser Web Push path or silently enable local/tab reminder scheduling.
Own authenticated device registration/update/read/delete succeeds; anonymous/foreign user/account reassignment and server-health edits fail directly.
Main app and Business explicit sign-out retire current-device server association/browser subscription or follow a recorded safe failure recovery without blocking requested Auth sign-out.
Delayed permission/subscribe/lookup/save/reconcile completion during account switch cannot mutate or display the wrong user's device association.
Permission revocation, disabled/expired endpoint and re-registration clear stale associations/badges and respect explicit prior opt-in.
Multiple tabs/devices/accounts and unique endpoint conflicts preserve rightful binding; removing this device does not remove another valid device.
Auth expiry/forced sign-out/offline cleanup/reinstall/provider registration change cannot retain unintended cross-account delivery; recovery/retention is auditable.
Default push preview contains only approved generic copy, never payment names/amounts, workspace/customer identities, proofs or secrets.
Detailed previews follow approved recipient/device/workspace authority and actual lock-screen/foreground privacy checks.
Turning previews off after enqueue redacts pending/retried content before send; current queued settings cannot preserve stale sensitive copy.
Malformed/oversized/control-rich payloads produce bounded generic display, approved icon/tag/badge and no executable/injected navigation.
Displayed retained notifications/badges and click handling across sign-out/account switch do not disclose the previous account's financial details.
Actual payload/provider/log/ledger retention and deletion agree with operator/privacy declarations without leaking raw endpoints, keys, proof or customer contents.
Test sender authenticates actual active account before dispatch and applies authoritative per-user cooldown; wrong origin/method/token/inadequate account status are denied.
Cron sender rejects missing/wrong/empty secret and malformed source before claim/send; browser public keys cannot trigger service dispatch.
Personal/Family paid/paused/deleted/reassigned/removed/suspended/settings changes cancel stale reminders before delivery.
Business bill fully-paid/due-date/workspace/owner/member/subscription/suspension changes invalidate stale reminders.
Admin recipient active account/role/unread source and source status are revalidated; removed/suspended/inadequate-role recipients receive no unauthorized alert.
In-app invitation/notification create/read/mark-read metadata and membership acceptance remain protected; invitation visibility is not an implicit push pipeline or access grant.
